pawn_policy: No combat pawns. Reference moves retain their historical notation.
capture_policy: Enemy combat only. Opera accepts any enemy capture in matches; its reference shows the knight capture.

games.title: The Birthday Queen
games.clue: Offer a rook-protected queen with check, then let the rook continue.
steps: Queen checks the king from a square protected by a rook
The protecting rook hits the same king with check

games.title: The Marathon
games.reference: The 136-move game; adaptation of rook-and-knight coordination, not a pawn-free reproduction of its ending.
games.clue: Rook, knight, rook: guard the knight and cover the queen's exits.
steps: Rook hits the enemy queen, protecting a knight that covers her escape squares
That knight hits the same queen while the rook protects its landing square
After the queen moves, the same rook hits her again, still protecting the knight; the knight covers her escape squares
games.clarification: User-selected replacement for impossible mutual protection: rook protects knight; knight covers queen escapes on the opening and closing rook strikes. Landing on the queen replaces escape coverage with a hit.

games.title: A Night at the Opera
games.players: Paul Morphy - Duke Karl and Count Isouard
games.clue: A bishop supports the rook; sacrifice the queen and close the file.
steps: Enemy captures the queen; original reference: a knight capture
Checkmate with the supported rook checking and the bishop still protecting it

games.title: Game of the Century
games.clue: Expose the queen with a bishop check; let the knight uncover another.
steps: A bishop move checks the king and exposes the queen to an enemy
Knight hits a different enemy while uncovering a check from the other bishop

games.title: The Immortal
games.reference: The original sacrifices both rooks as well. This adaptation recognises the final minor-piece net.
games.clue: Both knights close the exits; give up the queen for a bishop finish.
steps: Both knights contribute coverage around the enemy king
Checkmate: bishop checks, both knights cover escape squares

games.title: The King Hunt
games.clue: Give up a rook, check with its partner, then pursue with the queen.
steps: The other rook checks and hits the king
After the king changes square, the queen checks and hits it
